extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n where n is a real number, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is a constant and f(x) is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical function of the form a^x or e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The function e^x, which equals its own derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The function a^x, whose derivative is a^x · ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Mathematical Constant e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Represents the instantaneous rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The process of finding the derivative of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects to differentiation via the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The first derivative of position with respect to time, v(t) = s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of velocity, a(t) = v'(t) = s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Position
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function s(t) whose derivative yields velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: In economics, defined as C'(x), the derivative of the cost function.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative connects differentiation to real-world problems.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Appears in the derivative formula for general exponential functions as ln a.
